card.name: Words leading into superlatives like oldest
card.fires_on: Small words such as 'the', 's, 'to' and 'in', or a superlative itself, right where a 'first', 'oldest', 'fastest' or 'best' claim is about to be completed. It is general web text, not drug labels.

modes.label: Before a superlative
modes.description: A 'the' or possessive 's that sits just before a ranking word like fastest, most populous or Year.
modes.example: they now host the world<<'s>> fastest supercomputer.

modes.label: The superlative itself
modes.description: A ranking word such as oldest, best or sole, with more of the claim still to come.
modes.example: a sample of the<< oldest>> writing ever found in the Americas.

modes.label: Linking word in a 'last/first to' claim
modes.description: A small word like 'to' or 'in' inside a claim of being the last, first or oldest.
modes.example: the factory was the last in Seoul<< to>> produce coal briquettes

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words meaning 'one of the most' or 'the most', such as 之一 and 最.
card.plain: It notices when a sentence is building a claim of being the best, oldest or first.
